name: Chemical and Biochemical Engineering PhD
summary: Research doctorate in Chemical and Biochemical Engineering at Rutgers New Brunswick, with its own application selection.
detailsNote: Central programme directory explicitly confirms Fall 2027 January 15, 2027 deadline. Mentor-selection admission model not established. Department and central English exemption wording differ; approval should be confirmed.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application, US/non-US
deadlines.note: Current official directory; also departmental date for fellowship/assistantship consideration. No time specified.

applicationFee.note: Central automatic eligibility review for Rutgers alumni/employees, listed scholar programmes and active US military/veterans planning GI Bill benefits. Select applicable scholar affiliation in application. No general overseas hardship waiver established; international applicants must confirm eligible affiliation. Separate fee per programme, nonrefundable. FreeApp is a separate competitive route requiring US citizenship/PR, bachelor completion by August before enrollment, undergraduate GPA at least 3.0 and academic/research career intent. Rutgers FreeApp processing closes June 30, 2027 as the programme ends; requests must still permit meeting the relevant application deadline.

english.toefl: Through January 21, 2026: W22/S23/R21/L17; January 22 onward: W4.5/S4.5/R4/L4
english.note: TOEFL iBT/Home Edition accepted. Official scores sent directly by agency, within two years of entry semester. Central DET admission range 120–130; programme may set higher. Entire degree at principal-English institution may qualify case-by-case with official transcript language or letter sent directly by institution/Registrar; not automatic approval. CBE explicitly sets DET 120. Department exemption includes US citizen/PR or international applicant with minimum three undergraduate years or master degree taught in English; central requires completed entire degree and case-by-case proof, so confirm departmental exemption approval.

documents: Personal statement describing motivation, research areas and potential faculty advisers
Transcripts showing all courses, credits and final grades; unofficial for application, official for final admission
English evidence unless approved exemption; international transcript evaluation optional
requirements.note: Students with diverse educational backgrounds including non-chemical-engineering degrees may apply. GRE optional if helpful. Fall admission only for PhD. CBE cannot issue fee waiver itself; central affiliation routes govern.

funding.note: All admitted full-time PhDs receive TA/GA/fellowship funding and can expect at least five years with satisfactory progress; full stipend and tuition remission. The universal offer covers all admitted full-time PhDs, including international students. No current amount or health-insurance coverage established.

sources.label: Official source: cbe.rutgers.edu — graduate applicant criteria
